column3: The address O man is not expressed.
Revelation and righteous judgment are combined as “judgment will be revealed.”
“God” supplies the subject of the relative clause.
“He will give” supplies the verb from the preceding context.
The passive being called a Jew is rendered as “call yourself a Jew.”
“Because” makes the participial phrase explicitly causal.
“As it is written” is moved to the start.
Uncircumcision is specified as “a man who is not circumcised.”
“Only” is supplied with the description of circumcision.
